balls.text: and again! Same area, this was full on the middle stump and Ojha made just a hint of room and smacked that along the ground and beat a diving Pollard at mid-off
bashed a full delivery wide of cover, this was a touch wide, cover and mid-off in place and he bisects the gap
that's a direct hit and Irfan is in trouble! Drills it down to cover and he sets off and doesn't run straight, there's a direct hit at the bowler's end and Irfan has just about got his bat in
full on the pads and he works it down to long-on
soft dismissal for Rahul, he moved across his stumps looking to scoop it to fine leg, it was the off cutter, top edged it and an easy one for Gautam
good yorker to begin with, hits the pads and the ball rolls away

brilliantly done by Pollard! Slower ball from Anderson and Sammy fetched that from outside off and looked to clear long-on, didn't get the distance and Pollard ran forward, kept his eyes on it and took it inches off the turf on the dive
Sammy was looking to slog that but got an outside edge that cleared short third man
that was far too wide outside off and sammy was down on the ground attempting to reach out
that's the better length, fires that full and quick outside off and Sammy couldn't dig it out
Anderson slides this down the leg side
that answers the question as he tees off from ball one! Pitched up and Sammy dragged his left leg well forward and sent that several miles in the air and big over long-on
Warner tries one switch hit too many! Anderson was round the wicket, it was full and Warner was looking to send that over deep midwicket (to the right-hander), thick edge to the keeper
And Anderson is welcomed to the crease with a slog, length ball, Warner made room and it just cleared deep midwicket
Warner makes room and looks to slog and again he mistimes it, gets an inside edge to the leg side and Zaheer smiles this time, I suppose all's well now! It is, as Warner smiles back too

Warner made room early looking to slog and he ended up getting an inside edge to the pads, and things getting spicy between Warner and Zaheer as they exchange words and glares! Warner puts his index finger on his helmet grill suggesting to Zaheer to keep quiet
good length outside off and he makes room and forces it to long-off
full on the stumps and Warner could only drill it just wide of the bowler
comes round the wicket, on the stumps and he flicks it to midwicket
good comeback by Malinga as he bowls the slower yorker and Warner can only drill it down the track
fires that full outside off and he drives to cover
fuller one on the pads and worked down to long-on
drives that firmly to Harbhajan at extra cover and hurries the single, there's an overthrow

that was the switch hit off Malinga! Warner had the audacity to try that against him, he turned quickly and changed the grip and dabbed it wide of Ojha at short fine leg who leaps to his right, gets a hand to it but can't hang on, so that would be a drop
fires that full on the off stump and he drills it down the track wide of the bowler
he moves across the stumps and sweeps him behind square
and he punches this one down to long-off and gets his fifty! Warner looking dangerous now
miles over long-on! That was one mighty slog by Warner, length ball, on his knee and that went several rows back
gets forward and drives to long-off
pushes this one past cover

and the umpire Dharmasena is down! For starters Pollard bowled a high full toss which he was penalised for, Warner wanted to bash this down the ground but Pollard's hand came in the way and he deflected it to Dharmasena who was struck on the shoulder, Dharmasena went down and immediately penalised Pollard who was very apologetic
Rahul went down the track and chipped it down the ground, nearly reached the rope though, cut off by long-on
he stays back and punches it to short third man
into the stands over deep midwicket, tossed up and Warner was on his knee early and sent that a few rows over deep midwicket
he stays back and punches it to point
gets forward and chips it down to long-off
goes back and punches it to the off side
for the second time today Ojha fires it down the leg side and beats everyone, the keeper couldn't do anything  and Warner didn't offer a shot
punches it down to deep point
take cover KL! This was a slower ball and shorter, Warner bashed it down the ground with brute force nearly taking the non-striker with him, that was one powerful backhand
this was a yorker outside off and he drills it firmly back to the bowler who nearly flings it back
full on the pads and he works it cover
that was good timing! Short of a length, Rahul made room early, looked to force it away but instead placed it well wide of point, middled that one
full on the pads and he flicks it down to midwicket
down the leg side and flicked to short fine leg
stays back and works it against the turn to square leg
he fires that really quick and he dabs it down to short third man
full on the pads and he works him wide of midwicket
Rahul plays the reverse sweep and plays it fine, short third man charges
pushes it down to sweeper cover
dabs it just wide of short third man and Ojha dives and cuts it off
slower ball and he shuffles and works it to fine leg
Pollard taking the pace off the ball and making it tougher for Warner, he chops it hard to deep point
this was outside off and he cuts it to deep point
stays beside the line and punches it wide of point
this was too full and wide and he drives it down to long-off
fires it  on the stumps and he punches it wide of cover and sets off
he goes for the reverse sweep this time but it's in the air for a while but enough to clear short third man
looks to run it down to third man but can't beat short third man
stays back and pushes it wide of point
stays back and punches it wide of cover
went through with the arm and skidded, he just about chopped it away
angling across and he punches it wide of point to the sweeper
a little shorter and he was on his toes as he guided that wide of backward point
the keeper is up to the stumps, close call for Warner as he looked to run it down to third man and was beaten, the keeper fumbled
slower ball and he opens the face and runs it down to short third man
Pollard delivers that from a few yards behind the crease, more than a few yards in fact, Warner drives to long-off
the off cutter, he shuffles and tucks it to the leg side
full on the stumps and driven down to cover
quicker one and he turns it to square leg
softly tucked to the on side and Zaheer picks up
a little shorter and he pulls against the turn
quicker one, no room and he punches it to the off side
he stays back and punches it to the off side
stays back and whips it to square leg
tossed up and he gets forward and drives it down to long-off
he opens the face and runs it down to short third man
tossed up on middle and leg, Warner was on his knee quickly and he slogged it flat over deep midwicket
terrible ball, tossed up really wide down the leg side, the wicketkeeper couldn't do anything
this was dragged a bit short, he went for the pull but couldn't beat short midwicket
tossed up and he stabbed at it as he went forward, just wide of cover
this one skidded through as he looked to cut, beaten
goes back at the crease and punches it down to long-on
tossed up and he stays back and clips it just wide of square leg
tossed up and he gets forward and pushes it just wide of the bowler
gets forward and drives to the off side
tossed up and he comes down the track and gets an outside edge to the off side
slower ball on the pads and he tucks it wide of midwicket
Malinga keeps it tight, on the stumps and he defends down the track
that's a low full toss on the pads, he flicks it behind square on the on side
packed off side field, Warner drove it just wide of point and Dunk did well to run to his left and cut it off, they pick up a run though
this was a half volley outside off and Malinga was lucky Warner failed to get it past cover
slower ball by Malinga, flicked with soft hands to the on side and he sets off
spooned to cover! Zaheer fired that on a good length outside off, Finch was looking to punch it through the off side but failed to keep it down, Dunk jumps at cover and takes it easily
keeps it straight and he knocks it to the off side
he gets forward and pushes it to the off side

okay that was risky! There was a slip and Rahul wasn;t afraid to glide that to third man, it was a slower ball he had to adjust quickly, kept it down and it bounced in front of Harbhajan, beat him and rolled away to third man
fullish in length outside off and he gets forward and drives him wide of point
Zaheer continues round the wicket, bangs it in short and he swivels to pull but misses
tossed up and he drives him down to long-off
nicely driven, Rahul used his feet and danced down the track, met the ball on the half volley and drove it inside out wide of point
he shuffles and clips that to the on side
take that! Premeditated by Finch as he made room very early, gave himself width to carve that over the covers
tossed up outside off and he makes room and cuts him to point
comes round the wicket and bowls it full, driven firmly down the track
nicely defended on the back foot by Rahul, Zaheer keeps it straight

Zak's struck back after the boundary, this was on a good length outside off, Dhawan didn't have the width to drive unlike the previous ball, he went for the drive anyway, took the outside edge and comfortably taken by Harbhajan at first slip
hammered away, this was too wide outside off, Dhawan was anyway forward and he slapped that in the air wide of cover
Zaheer gets away with it this time, short and on the body, he swivels to pull but mistimes it to short fine leg
good length on middle and leg, he stays back and knocks it to the on side
slower ball this time, read it late and softly pushed it towards mid-on, Dhawan set off and had to scamper back
this was swinging in on a yorker length, mistimed the drive wide of mid-on
good length outside off and moving away, opens the face and runs it down to third man
this was nice and straight, on the stumps and he defends on the back foot
this was on a good length outside off and he stays beside the line and punches it wide of point
swings it towards the pads, hurried him for pace, dribbles off his body
fires that full outside off and driven firmly but straight to cover
that's the Zaheer we know  better, squared him up outside off by one that straightened, beaten all ends up
and just when fine leg comes up Zaheer makes the blunder by bowling on the pads, flicked away fine and the fielder dives in vain
that wasn't a bad ball at all actually, it was swinging in on a yorker length and Finch flicked that pretty well, placed it wide of square leg
this was drifting on the pad and he tried to flick it away, struck the pad and it's another leg bye
Finch moves right across his stumps and the ball hits his thigh and rolls to the off side
and Irfan bowls a super last over! This was a loopy full toss and he swings and misses., Irfan leaps and celebrates with his captain Dhawan
another good inswinging yorker which just missed the leg stump, good take there by Ojha
just a leg bye, not enough, full and the ball rolls to the off side
good bowling again, this was full and wide outside off and Gautam can't dig it out
low full toss swinging in on the leg stump and he swings it to deep midwicket

inside edge! Irfan bowls round the wicket and swings it towards the stumps, Pollard looks to swipe it across the line but gets an inside edge onto the stumps, Pathan's animated and Mumbai have lost their best hope
Gautam shuffles across his stumps and looks to play the ramp shot and ends up placing it to Mishra at short fine leg and they don't take the single
not a bad start at all! This was swinging in wide outside the leg stump and Gautam had made a lot of room and yet managed to drive that inside out wide of cover, take that for placement
the captain's done the honors, this was fired in full on the stumps, he made room to slam that wide of cover but ended up smacking it to Dhawan at cover
another swing and a miss, although off a straighter ball
returns over the wicket, he bowls the slower ball and it's wide outside off and Harbhajan swings and misses, after a lot of thought Dharmasena gives it a wide
he comes round the wicket and risks bowling a full toss, this was hammered and the umpire Dharmasena did well to duck, long-on was quite straight
good yorker on the stumps and he drills it down to long-off to get Pollard on strike
and now Steyn bowls it shorter and has the big man weaving backwards, Pollard didn't have room, top over
another top notch ball to Pollard, it was too quick and on a yorker length outside off, he can't dig it out
Tare backs away to give himself room for the big hit, he fetches it high on the body and gets a top edge that goes miles up in the air, the keeper Ojha does the honours
good length outside off and timed the punch well to sweeper cover, the throw is flat to the keeper and Tare is home
that's a top notch delivery, swinging away and quick, yorker length and dug out to the off side
Steyn comes on and Tare makes room and chops it just wide of cover where Dhawan chases
Pollard gets down for a premeditated paddle and he places it fine, 27 off the over!
Mishra dishes this too wide down the leg side and it's too wide for him to attempt a shot
flatter and on the pads and flicked away firmly towards Warner at deep midwicket
Mishra comes round the wicket and it doesn't help! Pollard stays forward and biffs it in the air and flat and down the ground, no hope for long-off
Three out of three and all in the same place! Tossed up on the off stump and this was lofted flatter and over Sammy's head at long-off
is this the over? Tossed up outside off and Pollard stays at the crease, bends and lofts a few rows more over long-off
bowl full tosses to Pollard at your own peril, Pollard just stays there and biffs it over long-off, went a few rows back
this was dragged a bit too short and Tare strikes it well, bounces wide of square leg and races away
cramped him for room as he chopped it towards the keeper
full on middle and leg and drilled down to long-on to bring up his fifty
that's a sharp inswinging yorker by Irfan, and Pollard does well to flick it away
the bowling change has worked! Irfan bowls this quite wide outside off and Rayudu has to really fetch that, playing against the line of the ball, he slogs but finds Warner at deep midwicket
over the wicket, this time he strays wide down the leg side, he tries to sweep but gets no bat on it
comes round the wicket, fires that full and wide outside off and he can only drive it to long-off
good slower ball to end the over, the legcutter and he was squared up
fires that full and he can only drill it down to long-on
good comeback by the bowler as he fires a yorker outside off and he cannot dig it out
fullish in length outside off and he slogs it to long-on
he finds the gap now! This was a short of a length ball and Rayudu was down the track and he smacked it over cover who leapt
awkward shot by Pollard, this was rising up on him and he stabbed it down to long-off
comes forward and gets an inside edge to the pad as he looks to force it away
Rayudu doesn't want to be left behind! He too skips down the track and lofts down the ground but it's flatter, beats long-on
bowls that quicker and he works it wide of square leg
heads up! Pollard dishes out the treatment to Sharma now, down the track and sends it over wide long-on
he comes down the track and lofts a full toss inside out to wide long-off
he stays back and punches it to long-on
Rayudu decides to open up as well and sweeps in front of square to deep midwicket
good comeback by Mishra as he bowls the big googly, forces Pollard to check his shot to the off side
turning out to be a big over! Tossed up and Pollard was down the track and lofted it over long-on
and Pollard is beaten for turn as he looks to force it down the ground and the bat flies off his hand and lands behind the keeper
he is opening up! Mishra tosses it up and Pollard was down the track and lofted it over long-off, and it wasn't timed that well too, raw power
that was a very friendly length, this was dragged too short, Pollard was waiting for that to release the pressure, pounded to deep midwicket
flatter delivery and he punches it down the pitch just wide of the bowler, good over by Karn keeping Pollard quiet
he comes down and lofts it inside out to wide long-off
frustration getting to him! He was forward looking to force it away but was cramped for room and had to defend it, Pollard nearly kicked the ball away in frustration
Pollard skips down the track and has to check his shot on seeing the turn, good bowling
tossed up and he fetches that from outside off and sweeps
drops this one short and he rocks back and punches it to point
stays back and punches it back to the bowler
comes forward and pushes it to point and Rayudu sets off, the fielder does well to dive and throw it to the keeper in one motion, appeal for a run out but Rayudu was safe
turn, turn turn! Squared up Pollard, he was forward to defend and that really turned square
flatter delivery and Pollard is happy to defend, another dot ball though
he stays back and punches this down the ground to long-on
this was short on middle and leg, the right length for Pollard to pull in front of square, better over for Mumbai
drops it towards point and Rayudu sets off first and so does Pollard, Pollard scampers back
that was a lot full toss which he fails to put away, mistimes it to midwicket
the opening Rayudu needed, the loopy slower ball, he gets on his knee and exploits the gap at midwicket, no chance of stopping that
good length outside the off stump and he angles it down to third man
this was short of a length and he stays back and clips it to square leg
slower and shorter and he works it against the turn to midwicket
spins away and he punches it down to long-on
that was the googly and he stays back and punches it to midwicket
he drops this one short and he stays back and pulls down to long-on
fires that on the pads and he works it behind square on the leg side
flatter one and he can only defend it back to the bowler
tossed up and he works it to the leg side
tossed up and he gets forward and defends
this was fired full and flicked to the leg side, Aaron Finch threw to the bowler's end but he was way off the mark! Must have slipped out, the throw went towards mid-off
beaten yet again! Rayudu looks to pull and he swishes at thin air, something's got to give here
Rayudu risks the same shot again, this was pitched up and moving away, beaten

chance at slip and dropped! Strange old shot by Rayudu, he backed away and meekly poked his bat out, went between keeper and slip and Sammy could have hung on had he moved a bit quicker to his left, all happened in a flash
the short one finally! Forced Pollard to go right back and take that on the knuckles, did well to keep it down
Steyn's not giving much room yet, this was on the off stump and Pollards defended it again
solid in defence, this was pacy and on the stumps and Pollard was happy to get forward and defend
he strays far too wide down the leg side
a bit too straight and he shuffles and tucks it to square leg
the keeper is up to the stumps, Dunk was at the crease looking to pull, Sammy bowled the off cutter and it skidded through, deflected off the pads and onto the stumps
stays beside the line and angles it down to third man
he stays on the back foot and punches it towards cover
that was raw power, it was a slower one and too short, Dunk slammed that off the back foot, too quick for cover
Dhawan dives full length to his left to stop that, well done
he stays back and knocks it down the track
goes for the drive but gets a thick outside edge, beats Bhuvi at short third man who doesn't time his dive right, gets up and chases but in vain
works it behind square on the on side and Warner's throw isn't quick enough to prevent the second run
in the slot for Dunk to scoop this comfortably over mid-off, no turn for Karn
Sharma bowls it flat and quick, worked to the on side
good length outside the off stump and he punches it to cover, very over from Bhuvi here
good length on the stumps and he punches it firmly down to mid-on
punches it off the bottom half of the bat to cover
moves away from him and he is sliced in half, beaten for movement
swings away and he stays beside the line and works it to point
he stays beside the line and punches it to point
he strays down the leg side
148kph, short and pushed a little too far down the leg side. He goes for a pull and the ump says he's got wood on it
steams in and sends a 141 k thunderbolt that is allowed to thud into the keeper's gloves. Shortish and in that off stump corridor

what a ball! Anderson has had a torrid time against the pace Steyn is generating. So he goes for the innovation. Gets on one-knee and looks to scoop a short of a good length delivery over the keeper. Unwise shot against someone of this pace. Only gloves it and the keeper pouches an easy take
full and pushed wide to entice him, Anderson looks to lace it over the covers and misses. Again no feet
shortish on middle, Anderson drops it towards midwicket but the fielders swoop down on it quickly
147 kph, Anderson is rooted to the crease as he wafts at a good length ball that is angled across him. Steyn goes up in a big appeal, but the keeper is late to follow and the umpire says no.
on the hips and he clips, towards midwicket
good length ball pushing in at his pads, Anderson nudges towards the leg side and the bowler takes care of it
back of a length and just outside off, defended
just short of a good length as he goes back and blocks with a straight face
fuller ball, but a directed a little too far outside off

big gap between bat and pad as he exhibits a lazy drive down the ground. Bhuvi gets this to dart back in quite late  and off stump takes a clattering. Mumbai's batting is treading familiar territory once again
full and a little swing outside off, he goes forward and blocks with a bit of an open face
short and wide, Dunk gets up on his toes and slaps it over the head of point. Crisp, but a little dangerous

back of a length and outside off, Rohit dabs into the off side and hesitates. Dunk is haring across so he has to run. Cover races in and sends an underarm thrown on the dive and had that hit, it would have been curtains for Dunk. Hits the marker behind the stumps and deflects away
fullish on middle, Rohit nudges it from the crease to midwicket
just short of a good length and the ball curls away after pitching, Rohit won't be enticed by it
shapes in off a fuller length, Dunk pushes away from his body a little and gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg
fullish on off stump, he defends to mid-off
